brief: Prioritise this unit for pre-event attention, as an ageing unit with a history of high loading has a reduced margin against mechanical failure under sustained heat exposure [MG-023]. Where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to restore the unit's cooling margin [SOP-011]. Obstructed ventilation must also be cleared in preference to deferring it, restoring the cooling margin across consecutive warm nights [SOP-015].
